# Review: The Weeknd closes trilogy with 6th studio album
A graphic created by senior Jake Radcliffe on Canva displays an alternate cover of The Weeknd's sixth album, "Hurry Up Tomorrow." The new project released Jan. 31. A movie of the same name as the new album will release May 16.
Photo courtesy of XO and Republic Records

...

Pop and R&B artist [Abel Tesfaye](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_Weeknd) , professionally known as The Weeknd, released his sixth studio album, “Hurry Up Tomorrow,” on Jan. 31.
This album brings the story of the character of The Weeknd, which started in the artist’s first mixtape, [“House of Balloons,”](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/House_of_Balloons) to a close.
The singer-songwriter stated that this album would be his last release under the moniker of The Weeknd.

...

According to The Weeknd, this project closes out a trilogy that includes earlier albums [“After Hours”](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/After_Hours_(The_Weeknd_album)) and [“Dawn FM.”](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dawn_FM) A prominent fan theory suggests that this trilogy takes
inspiration from [Dante Alighieri’s](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dante_Alighieri) “ [Divine Comedy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Divine_Comedy) ,” with the albums representing a trip through Hell in “After Hours,” Purgatory in “Dawn FM,” and Paradise in “Hurry Up Tomorrow.”

...

Although this is his last album that will be released under his alter ego, Tesfaye will continue releasing music, perhaps as himself or another character. It’s unknown when Tesfaye will next release music, but fans will not have to wait long for a new project from the artist.

# The Weeknd’s ‘Hurry Up Tomorrow’ marks end of era
For fans of the world renowned music star The Weeknd, Friday, Jan 31, 2025 could not have arrived any faster. At the end of Jan. 2025, the artist released his sixth and final studio album under his persona as The Weeknd.
Titled “Hurry Up Tomorrow,” the album marks the end of an era for many, and also concludes a three album trilogy. While The Weeknd has hinted he will continue making music under his legal name “Abel Tesfaye,” it is unclear what path he will really take.

...

The Weeknd’s other albums in the trilogy (After Hours and Dawn FM), tell stories of heartbreak, despair, and healing. In Hurry Up Tomorrow, Tesfaye also touches on the adversity he faced on tour in 2023.

...

Fans will be able to enjoy The Weeknd’s new album on his new “After Hours Til Dawn tour.” Hitting major venues all across the United States and Canada, he will be able to say goodbye to fans before stepping away from his persona and returning to his roots as Abel Tesfaye.

# The Weeknd releases ‘Hurry Up Tomorrow,’ his final album by the ‘The Weeknd’ persona
The Weeknd performs a song on stage at the 67th Grammy awards. The Weeknd released his sixth and final studio album Jan. 31 going under the "The Weeknd" persona. (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello)
The Weeknd performs a song on stage at the 67th Grammy awards. The Weeknd released his sixth and final studio album Jan. 31 going under the “The Weeknd” persona. (AP Photo/Chris Pizzello)
By [Kahlil Kambui](https://northernstar.info/staff_name/kahlil-kambui/) , Assistant Lifestyle Editor
Feb 5, 2025
“Hurry Up Tomorrow” is The Weeknd’s sixth and last studio album by his persona “The Weeknd,” and it is the perfect send off.
The Weeknd, Abel Makkonen Tesfay, has this perfect way of making each of his albums feel grand; “Hurry Up Tomorrow” is no different.
Normally, an album with a whopping 22 tracks would have been a turn-off, but due to the length and aesthetic of the album, it made it feel like the music equivalent of a best picture.
